module.name: prompt
module.purpose: Loads, validates, injects, and renders named prompt templates and reusable prompt modules, including compact benchmarked parent/current boundaries, whole-current-task action classification, exact-current-task completion evidence, earlier-chunk fact recaps, and optional cursor-return guidance.

childModules.name: module
childModules.purpose: Defines reusable prompt fragments embedded into rendered templates: compact BackgroundTaskContextHeader and CurrentTaskContextHeader fragments delimit parent facts and current-task evidence, CompletedCalls marks final current-task evidence, RepeatInvocation warns about repeated calls, and PreChunk frames earlier summary facts.

childModules.name: template
childModules.purpose: Defines System, WorkflowPolicy, ToolCallSummarize, and ToolCallSummarizeWithCursor resources; the compact benchmarked workflow prompts require multi-stage tasks to Plan, exact single operations to use their ordinary tool, evidenced tasks to complete, explicit permanent blockers to be infeasible, and known one-file fixes to use replace_in_file without another read.
